title: Some People

location.series: Pentagram / The Public Theater case study

slide_intent: Coordinate portrait variation with type because a performer’s range can be communicated within one composition.
strategic_value: Two contrasting figures can suggest multiplicity while gold lettering holds the production information together.
demonstration: Red and blue cutout figures stand on black beneath tall gold SOME PEOPLE typography and stacked credits.
practical_value: Compare separate color treatments for two figures against a unified typographic palette.

content_islands.name: Heading
content_islands.spec: Place tall gold title lettering across the top.

content_islands.name: Figures and credits
content_islands.spec: Balance the red figure at left and blue figure at right around compact gold credit blocks.
